question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b499858102eb398d7ee722b82b62ca347622b7d61207d858d9450457c86aa773.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: **The lower number is the sum of the cube of the two upper number.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/049cf087dc902b5f37181ee3e7bdb4ab378dd89f146f6fc3f7b21a06a2e79945.png] 

→ 91 = (3)³ + (4)³ 

→ 91 = 27 + 64

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9882cc2776a8827b159b439efc3ede6defae78a68c3cb0ebdb0840ed0ddbab1d.png] 

→ 133 = (2)3 + (5)3 

→ 133 = 8 + 125

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/08fe3b9f619e0805104f333a196abb01f876e61885ec95e36219644fca2932b2.png] 

→ ? = (6)3 + (1)3 

→ ? = 216 + 1 = 217

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
